name: MedFund call for beneficiaries: Mediterranean MPA management
summary: Grants to management and co-management structures of Mediterranean marine protected areas to cover recurrent management costs such as surveillance, monitoring, staff and small equipment, in ten priority countries.

geography.label: Priority intervention countries in the Mediterranean

eligibility.rule: Be an officially established MPA or one in the process of being established
Have an approved management plan or management orientation document
Have a dedicated operational management unit or team
Not already be a beneficiary of The MedFund
Have national authority approval or support when applying as an NGO
Ensure activities comply with the fund's environmental and social requirements

documents: Activities description for the next 5 years
Legal status of the MPA, if officially established
National authority approval or support letter
Legal registration documents of the beneficiary NGO
Passports of the President and director of the management organization
Passports of the President and director of the beneficiary NGO
Latest financial report of the beneficiary NGO

status.quote: The Call for Expressions of Interest is now closed.

deadline.quote: Phase 2: Preparation and submission of the application, by 2nd October 2026 (midnight CEST)

applicant_types.quote: Any application submitted by a non-governmental organization must be accompanied by a letter of approval or support from the national authorities responsible for marine protected areas.

geography.quote: Priority intervention countries are as follows: Albania, Algeria, Croatia, Egypt, Greece, Lebanon, Morocco, Montenegro, Tunisia and Türkiye.

access.quote: The MedFund provides technical and financial support through grants to management and co-management structures of Mediterranean MPAs

window.quote: This call for expressions of interest is organized in two phases: Phase 1: Expression of interest, until 31st of July 2026

effort.quote: Phase 1: Expression of interest, until July 31st, 2026

Submit your complete application package (Application Form, Activity Description File, Funding Request, and all supporting documents) via email to contact@themedfund.org by 2nd of October 2026, at midnight CEST

eligibility.quote: Be an officially established MPA or one that is in the process of being established in one of the following countries: Albania, Algeria, Croatia, Egypt, Greece, Lebanon, Morocco, Montenegro, Tunisia and Türkiye.
Have a management plan approved by national authorities or, in the absence of one, a management orientation document.
Have a dedicated operational management unit/team.
A MPA that is already a beneficiary of The MedFund is not eligible for this call for interest.
Any application from a non-governmental organization must be accompanied by a letter of approval or support from the national authorities responsible for marine protected areas management.

The MedFund applies the environmental and social procedures established by the Global Environment Facility (GEF) and the exclusion list of the French Development Agency (FDA). Therefore, all activities deemed non-compliant with these three documents will not be eligible for funding from the Fund.

after_award.quote: Between each phase, the MedFund executive direction evaluates on-site the improvements made in the management of the beneficiary MPA, and beneficiaries must submit an application for the next phase.

documents.quote: A description of the activities planned and budgeted for the next 5 years. 3. A detailed funding request specifying the financial needs in euros by expense item and the mobilized co-financing. The funding request must be accompanied by the following annexes: 4. A zoning map, 5. The legal status of the MPA (if officially established),

A letter of approval or support signed by the national authority responsible for MPA management. Any application submitted by an NGO without the letter of approval or support will be considered incomplete and will not be reviewed by The MedFund Grant Award Committee. 7. An updated management plan or document,

The legal registration documents of the beneficiary NGO (statutes, certificates, etc.), 9. A photo of the MPA with associated photo credits, 10. A copy of the passport of the President and the director of the management organization, 11. A copy of the passport of the President and the director of the beneficiary NGO, 12. The latest financial report (2025) of the beneficiary NGO,
